title: Prompt Robustness Is Task-Dependent: Comparing Objective and Belief-Style Questions in LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models' susceptibility to position bias, recency bias, and label-token bias by applying structural perturbations like option shuffling, formatting changes, and label substitution to multiple-choice tasks.
Measuring the stability of inferred political positions by evaluating model consistency on the Political Compass Test under semantically equivalent prompt paraphrases and structural variations.
Assessing the robustness of expressed social and cultural values by testing models on the World Values Survey, ValueBench, and CulturalBench across multiple prompt perturbations.
